cases.name: Robin Elizabeth Waddell
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Robin always marched to the beat of her own drum. Even though quiet and reserved, she went on to accomplish many great things in her life. In 1980, she married the love of her life, Phillip Alfred Waddell, and together they raised a beautiful family. Robin had a big heart and loved those that surrounded her. Throughout her life, she was an advocate for animals and was always rescuing animals that needed help. She enjoyed the outdoors, a good plate of Mexican food, and her family who meant the world to her. The love Robin had for her grandchildren was immeasurable and everyone that saw her in their presence knew it."
cases.narrative: He allegedly knocked on a door of a vehicle, shot her dead as she sat at the wheel and stole her vehicle while he was fleeing after shooting a police officer.
